title: The First Message Ever Sent Over the Internet Crashed After Two Letters

scenes.text: The first message ever sent on the internet crashed.
October 29, 1969. A UCLA student tried to type the word login.
The computer was at Stanford Research Institute, hundreds of miles away.
Only the first two letters arrived: L, O.
About an hour later it recovered. The internet's first word was lo.

description:
The first message ever sent on the internet crashed.
In 1969 a UCLA student tried to send login to Stanford Research Institute over ARPANET. Only L and O arrived.
What would you have wanted the first message to be?
first_comment: If you could have sent the first internet message, what would it be?
